audience.title: Who This Is *Built For*

items.title: Senior Federal Employees
items.body: GS-14/15 or SES who've been the dependable one for 25–30 years and now want a clean, confident retirement plan.

items.title: Separating Military (O-4 to O-6)
items.body: Within 12–24 months of filing, with a firm target date and decisions that can't be reversed.

items.title: TSP/401(k)-Heavy Savers
items.body: Household income $220K–$450K and investable assets $900K–$3.5M, plus pension eligibility and Social Security.

items.title: Family-Focused
items.body: Often a blended family, an adult child still financially connected, or an aging parent — and a spouse who wants certainty.

audience.notFor: This isn't for early-career savers far from retirement, or anyone looking for product pitches and generic rules instead of a plan built around their numbers.

faqs.q: Will you try to sell me a product?
faqs.a: No. This is education-first. We start by getting your numbers clear so you can see your options and choose what fits your family — no fear-based pressure.

faqs.q: Can I really retire on my target date?
faqs.a: That's the first thing we answer. The Readiness Snapshot and Income Paycheck Draft give you a simple, defensible yes/no and the income number that comes with it.

faqs.q: What about my TSP and rollover timing?
faqs.a: Timing matters and some choices are hard to reverse. We build a decision calendar with guardrails so TSP/rollover, survivor elections, and Social Security are handled in the right order.

faqs.q: How do you reduce taxes in retirement?
faqs.a: We design a tax-aware withdrawal sequence across your accounts and identify where Roth conversions may fit, so you don't overpay or trigger avoidable brackets.

faqs.q: I have a blended family — can you help protect them?
faqs.a: Yes. We align beneficiaries, review survivor income and protection needs, and coordinate your estate path so your family isn't left with a probate mess.
Your initial Retirement Readiness Snapshot is free, with no obligation.
